summary: Iteration 10 - Verified NurseConnect Admin Portal enhancements. Added /app/backend/tests/test_workflow_wf10.py (8 new tests) covering: /api/admin/stats auth (401/403), shape+identity guarantee (total = verified + pending for both nurses & hospitals), stats-move-on-registration, admin PATCH /nurse_profile/<id> and /hospital/<id> with persistence via GET, admin-approval reflected in stats, and selected/joined report data-source integrity via admin /application, /job, /hospital. Full backend suite: 95/95 pass (87 preexisting + 8 new). Frontend E2E via Playwright: admin login -> /admin/dashboard renders all 12 required stat testids; identity assertion 1296=10+1286 (nurses) and 563=29+534 (hospitals) holds in the live UI; admin-count-reconciliation text matches exactly. Verification page shows EXACTLY 2 sections (verification-hospitals-section, verification-nurses-section) with hospital/nurse search boxes and vc-docs-hospital/vc-docs-nurse buttons opening verification-documents-dialog. Nurses page: nurse-filter-search present, review dialog opens, Edit Profile reveals edit-nurse-full_name etc., save-nurse-btn PATCHes and change persists across reload (verified with WF10Edit_<ts>). Hospitals page: hospital-filter-search, edit-hospital-btn -> edit-hospital-name + save-hospital-btn all present. Reports page (/admin/reports, admin-sidebar-nav-reports) shows exact columns Nurse Name|Hospital Name|Hospital Address|Joining Date|Status with all 4 filter testids interactive. No blocking issues.

issues: Several selected/joined rows show '—' for Nurse Name and/or Hospital Name and Hospital Address because the applications were created in prior iterations without nurse_name/hospital_name snapshotted on the app document, and the joined hospital record has no address fields. Frontend renders correctly given the data; consider back-filling from users/nurse_profiles when snapshot fields are missing so admins see meaningful values.
Preview DB is heavily inflated with prior iteration test data (1296 nurses, 563 hospitals, 445 jobs) - cosmetic only, does not affect correctness. Consider a purge of wftest_/wf8_/wf10_ before demo.
